_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_sports_small.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_cheer_ongoin: In her cheer skirt, $names$ parades the sideline along the route the team prescribed.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_cheer_result: Walk fast and the skirt fills with wind. Every gaze on the field sticks under its hem - by regulation, nothing may be worn beneath.
$names$ is called to lead the stretches. Each arm-raise sets the skirt swaying, and the stands' shutter clicks never stop - the team's publicity photos are also part of the business.
At halftime $names$ is posted at the players' tunnel to see each man onto the court. During the high-fives, hands keep 'missing' up under the skirt.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_water_ongoin: Training pauses; $names$ carries the cooler out to hand out water.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_water_result: At the third man the water bottle becomes his sports drink, and the delivery method changes too - "Kneel. Use your mouth." The interpreter doesn't translate, but the gesture translates itself.
$names$ goes down the line of resting players with water and towels. Where the towel reaches his waist, a hand presses it lower - "sweat there too."
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_locker_ongoi: Whistles carry out of the locker room, calling $names$ in to 'help with relaxation'.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_locker_resul: At the halftime whistle $names$ is called into the locker room to help the starting ace 'relax'. By the time she comes out, the second half is kicking off.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_suite_ongoin: In the evening $names$ is summoned to the suite to 'keep the team company'.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_suite_result: $names$ is assigned to the team leader's lap for the drinking. Three rounds in, he practices Chinese toasts with great enthusiasm - while the hand beneath never needs an interpreter.
Losers of the video game face a 'penalty round': the forfeit is $names$ sitting on the winner's lap, pinched everywhere over her skirt. The losers still join in the jeering.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_small_locker_resul: At the halftime whistle $names$ is called into the locker room to help the starting ace 'relax'. By the time she comes out, the second half is kicking off.
